Person.reason: CUSTOMER represents bank customers; some counterparties may also use this vertex.

Account.reason: ACCOUNT represents accounts held at the bank.

Transaction.reason: These represent transfers and teller movements; statement entries are derived postings and are excluded.

Device.reason: T24 has no device record; the sign-on terminal id is the nearest thing

IPAddress.reason: Protocol records contain an IP address, but it is stored as an attribute.

LoginEvent.reason: PROTOCOL records whose APPLICATION is SIGN.ON

Beneficiary.reason: A beneficiary vertex exists, but the schema does not distinguish external recipients from bank customers.

Card.reason: CARD_ISSUE represents cards issued by the bank.

Merchant.reason: No merchant vertex or merchant attribute is present.

InvestigationCase.reason: No investigation case vertex or case attribute is present.

OWNS.reason: Customer-to-account ownership and joint-holder edges are present.

PAYS.reason: Funds transfers link to beneficiary records.

FROM_DEVICE.reason: No device vertex or transaction-to-device path is present.

FROM_IP.reason: IP addresses are recorded on PROTOCOL, but there is no transaction-to-protocol edge path.

AT.reason: No merchant vertex or transaction-to-merchant path is present.

VIA.reason: Cards link to accounts, but no transaction-to-card path is present.

HOLDS.reason: Card issues link to their accounts.

LOGGED_IN.reason: A protocol record can reach a customer and their account, but the schema does not explicitly identify sign-ons.

LOGIN_FROM_DEVICE.reason: No device vertex or login-to-device path is present.

LOGIN_FROM_IP.reason: PROTOCOL stores IP_ADDRESS as an attribute, not as a linked IP vertex.

INVESTIGATED_IN.reason: No investigation case vertex or account-to-case edge is present.

Transaction.amount.reason: These fields record transfer and teller movement amounts.

Transaction.timestamp.reason: DATE_TIME is T24's YYMMDDHHMM audit stamp, the only time of day

Transaction.channel.reason: FT transaction-type codes; TELLER is cash at a branch

Account.open_date.reason: OPENING_DATE records when the account was opened.

Account.status.reason: Record status and posting restrictions can proxy active or restricted status.

Person.anonymized_ssn_hash.reason: The hashed legal ID may not specifically be an SSN or equivalent national ID.

Person.kyc_verified_at.reason: The last review date is a date-only proxy for identity verification time.

Beneficiary.bank_identifier.reason: BIC and sort code identify the beneficiary's bank.

Beneficiary.name_hash.reason: The beneficiary short-name hash is present.

InvestigationCase.status.reason: No investigation case or case-status field is present.

IPAddress.anonymizer.reason: No proxy, VPN, or Tor indicator is present.

account_under_investigation.reason: posting restriction 25 is this bank's fraud block

needs_review: Confirm the format of the string DATE_TIME fields; yyyymmddhhmmss is assumed.
Review the TRANSACTION_TYPE and TRANSACTION_CODE lookup values before treating them as channel proxies.
Confirm which PROTOCOL records represent sign-ons; no explicit login-event indicator is shown.
Confirm whether BENEFICIARY records can represent bank customers as well as external recipients.
Confirm that LEGAL_ID_HASH represents a national identity number suitable for the canonical hash field.

review.by: Claude (reviewer for the demo; the bank's data owner reviews for real)

changes.why: The proposal assumed YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; T24's DATE_TIME is a 10-character YYMMDDHHMM stamp. With the wrong format every transaction would have been dropped.
This bank's FUNDS.TRANSFER types OT and AC are entered through internet banking; TELLER records are cash.
The proposal left Device unmapped. PROTOCOL.TERMINAL_ID identifies the terminal a user signed on from. There is no edge from a transfer to a sign-on, so device detectors stay off for this bank.
F.PROTOCOL logs every activity; sign-ons are the rows with APPLICATION = SIGN.ON.
A TELLER record debits ACCOUNT.1 only when DR.CR.MARKER is DEBIT (a withdrawal).
A TELLER deposit credits ACCOUNT.1 when DR.CR.MARKER is CREDIT.
CALC/MANUAL.RISK.CLASS are AML risk classes, not a KYC score, and KYC.COMPLETE is YES/NO. Leaving it unmapped is better than a misleading number.
T24 has no case record; POSTING.RESTRICT 25 marks an account blocked for fraud.
